At that moment the enemies of the Jewish people,
were sentenced to destruction for flattering Agrippa.
From the day that the power of flattery prevailed,
the judgment has become corrupted, … and … deeds have become corrupted,
the judgment has become corrupted, and people’s deeds have become corrupted,
and a person cannot say to another:

p: Any person who has flattery in him falls into Gehenna,
“Woe to those who call evil good,
as the tongue of fire devours straw,
and as the chaff is consumed by the flame”
Anyone who flatters another ultimately falls into his hands.
And if he does not fall into his hands, … he falls into his children’s hands.
And if he does not fall into his hands, he falls into his children’s hands.
And if he does not fall into his children’s hands, … he falls into his grandchild’s hands,
And if he does not fall into his children’s hands, he falls into his grandchild’s hands,
“Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah…Amen,
the Lord should perform your words”
